description: Encoding-adaptive FileSystem backend: native UTF-8 / UTF-8 BOM passthrough with byte-exact edits for 16 legacy encodings (GBK, GB18030, Big5, Shift-JIS, EUC-KR, UTF-16, Windows-1250~1257, ISO-8859-1) and encoding-aware grep.

sandbox.description: Confine mutations with sandboxPolicy (SandboxedFileSystem). Disable only when no sandbox policy is used.
